subject: English
release_scope: RPH only, Units 2–4; no Activity Book page or dated RPT claimed

content_standards.1.1: Respond suitably to spoken input for different purposes.
content_standards.1.2: Develop pronunciation, stress, rhythm and intonation through listening.
content_standards.1.4: Understand and respond to spoken stories, visual material and songs or rhymes.
content_standards.2.1: Recognise, remember and comprehend vocabulary and short phrases through reading.
content_standards.3.2: Use appropriate sentence writing and punctuation.
content_standards.3.3: Communicate ideas creatively through suitable media and language.

learning_standards.1.1.1: Listen and give an appropriate response to a stimulus.
learning_standards.1.1.2: Show understanding of short spoken instructions.
learning_standards.1.2.1: Hear and pronounce vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.1.2.2(i): Listen to and sing nursery rhymes.
learning_standards.1.3.1: Respond to everyday conversation with support.
learning_standards.1.3.2(i): Join supported exchanges using basic greetings.
learning_standards.1.3.2(iii): Follow basic classroom directions with support during an exchange.
learning_standards.1.4.1(i): Demonstrate listening comprehension using yes/no responses.
learning_standards.1.4.1(ii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by judging statements true or false.
learning_standards.1.4.1(iii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by answering Wh-questions.
learning_standards.2.1.3: Read and show comprehension of vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.3.1.1: Copy and write familiar sight vocabulary legibly.
learning_standards.3.2.1(i): Use lowercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(ii): Use uppercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(iv): Use full stops correctly in sentences.

lessons.title: Body movement song
lessons.objective: Sing the target body-part words at three cues with appropriate support.
lessons.success_criterion: Sing the target body-part words at three cues with appropriate support.
lessons.induction: Teacher shows three body-part cards; pupils identify the corresponding parts.
lessons.guided: Teacher models the song and a seated or standing movement for each cue.
lessons.practice: Pupils select three body-part cards and sing the related words at three cues; gestures may be adapted or omitted.
lessons.support: Allow gaze or pointing; avoid demanding movement beyond ability
lessons.assessment: Record the three vocal responses; record non-vocal alternatives separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Sing the target body-part words at three cues with appropriate support.
lessons.source_note: Textbook p.5 prints 1.2.1(i), which has no subcode (i) in DSKP p.38. Song objective aligns with 1.2.2(ii).
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Body picture questions
lessons.objective: Answer five of seven spoken questions about body parts.
lessons.success_criterion: Answer five of seven spoken questions about body parts.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 6; Body outline, picture labels
lessons.induction: Find an elbow on a puppet
lessons.guided: Model questions and place labels on the outline
lessons.practice: Teacher asks seven Wh-questions using the body outline; pupils answer by naming, pointing or selecting the corresponding label.
lessons.support: Use a smaller choice set and visual prompts
lessons.closure: Choose a label for the puppet
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Identify five of seven named body parts. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer five of seven spoken questions about body parts.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: What my body can do
lessons.objective: Read and match four of five body-action phrases to pictures.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match four of five body-action phrases to pictures.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 7; Action cards, sentence strips
lessons.guided: Teacher reads one short body-action phrase and matches it to a picture.
lessons.practice: Pupils read five short body-action phrases in sentence strips and match them to pictures.
lessons.support: Underline the body word and use picture cues
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Match four of five action sentences to body pictures. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match four of five body-action phrases to pictures.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Face collage
lessons.objective: Produce a face collage with three recognisable labelled parts
lessons.success_criterion: Produce a face collage with three recognisable labelled parts
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 8; Precut shapes, glue, crayons
lessons.guided: Model placing a shape and writing its label
lessons.practice: Pupils arrange and attach shapes then add three labels using a word bank
lessons.support: Use large precut pieces and adaptive grips
lessons.closure: Present one label to a partner
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Produce a face collage with three recognisable labelled parts. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Produce a face collage with three recognisable labelled parts
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Introducing family members
lessons.objective: Read two family labels and use both to introduce fictional relatives.
lessons.success_criterion: Read two family labels and use both to introduce fictional relatives.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 9; Fictional family portraits, speech cards
lessons.guided: Model a short introduction for an aunt or uncle
lessons.practice: Pupils read two family labels, then introduce the fictional relatives to a partner.
lessons.support: Allow a recorded response or word card; no personal photos required
lessons.closure: Choose a relative word to repeat
lessons.assessment: Record the reading and supported conversational responses separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read two family labels and use both to introduce fictional relatives.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Family tree reading
lessons.objective: Read and locate four of six family labels
lessons.success_criterion: Read and locate four of six family labels
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 10; Fictional tree diagram, word cards
lessons.guided: Model reading and attaching the first label to a branch
lessons.practice: Pupils read six cards and place them in the correct positions
lessons.support: Offer colour-coded generations and two choices
lessons.closure: Point to the label read aloud
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Read and locate four of six family labels. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and locate four of six family labels
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Sentence punctuation
lessons.objective: Correct letter case and final full stops in three of four sentences.
lessons.success_criterion: Correct letter case and final full stops in three of four sentences.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 11; Sentence strips, two coloured pencils
lessons.induction: Compare one sentence with and without a full stop
lessons.guided: Teacher contrasts upper- and lowercase letters, models the sentence opening and ending, and demonstrates a full stop.
lessons.practice: Pupils correct capital letters, lowercase letters and full stops in four original family sentences.
lessons.support: Provide enlarged print and a coloured starting dot
lessons.closure: Check the punctuation of one sentence
lessons.assessment: Check the three punctuation features for each sentence.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Correct letter case and final full stops in three of four sentences.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Family picture frame
lessons.objective: Create a labelled frame collage with three attached paper elements.
lessons.success_criterion: Create a labelled frame collage with three attached paper elements.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 12; Cardboard frame, fictional photo, tape
lessons.guided: Teacher models assembling the frame and arranging cut paper elements into a labelled collage on its backing.
lessons.practice: Pupils arrange and attach at least three paper elements around a fictional family portrait and add a readable label.
lessons.support: Supply assembled frames and large word stickers
lessons.closure: Show the label on the frame
lessons.assessment: Check the collage composition and readable label; record support.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Create a labelled frame collage with three attached paper elements.
lessons.source_note: Adaptation adds a collage element to meet DSKP 3.3.1(ii); original textbook craft retained.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Thanks and apologies
lessons.objective: Respond politely in three of four role-play situations
lessons.success_criterion: Respond politely in three of four role-play situations
lessons.guided: Model thanking a helper and apologising for a mistake
lessons.practice: Pupils draw four scenarios and act out an appropriate response
lessons.support: Offer two phrase cards or speech output
lessons.closure: Choose the phrase for receiving help
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Respond politely in three of four role-play situations. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Respond politely in three of four role-play situations
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Permission and waiting
lessons.objective: Use two appropriate expressions in a classroom role-play
lessons.success_criterion: Use two appropriate expressions in a classroom role-play
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 14; Queue markers, permission cards
lessons.induction: Show two figures waiting at a counter
lessons.guided: Model asking permission and waiting for a reply
lessons.practice: Pairs practise asking to leave and joining a pretend queue
lessons.support: Provide visual turn-taking cues and a short script
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Use two appropriate expressions in a classroom role-play. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Use two appropriate expressions in a classroom role-play
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Telephone conversation
lessons.objective: Complete a greeting, request and farewell in a simulated call
lessons.success_criterion: Complete a greeting, request and farewell in a simulated call
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 15; Disconnected toy phones, fictional name cards
lessons.guided: Model a safe call using fictional names Practise a greeting and remind pupils not to share personal information with strangers.
lessons.practice: Partners take caller and receiver roles and complete the three exchanges
lessons.support: Offer picture prompts for conversation stages; do not disclose real contact details
lessons.assessment: Record the demonstrated criterion: Complete a greeting, request and farewell in a simulated call. Record prompts separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Complete a greeting, request and farewell in a simulated call
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Reading a manners story
lessons.objective: Match two story phrases, answer three of four spoken true/false statements and use one greeting.
lessons.success_criterion: Match two story phrases, answer three of four spoken true/false statements and use one greeting.
lessons.guided: Read the story in short sections and discuss picture clues
lessons.practice: Pupils read two short story phrases and match pictures. Teacher reads four original statements aloud; pupils show true/false. Pairs act out a greeting from the story.
lessons.support: Present one statement at a time and point to relevant picture
lessons.assessment: Record each of the three skills separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Match two story phrases, answer three of four spoken true/false statements and use one greeting.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.

lessons.title: Polite phrases display
lessons.objective: Create a leaf collage with three legible polite-phrase labels.
lessons.success_criterion: Create a leaf collage with three legible polite-phrase labels.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 18; Leaf-shaped cards, glue, word bank
lessons.induction: Read one example of a polite phrase
lessons.guided: Teacher models arranging leaf shapes on a display backing and adding readable polite-expression labels.
lessons.practice: Pupils select three leaf shapes, write or assemble three polite phrases and attach the leaves to create a tree collage.
lessons.support: Use preprinted word tiles for assembly
lessons.closure: Read one phrase from the display
lessons.assessment: Check attached leaves, readable labels and pupil participation.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Create a leaf collage with three legible polite-phrase labels.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook pages 5–18 and DSKP English standard text reviewed 2026-11-26; adapted activities are original.
